description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language type for the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

description.zh:
设置基线所属的类型。
> 调用[DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~)接口返回的**TypeName**字段。
description.en:
The type to which the baseline belongs.
> The **TypeName** field returned by calling the [DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~) operation.

description.zh:
指定要查询的服务器的UUID。多个UUID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
> 您可调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取服务器的UUID。
description.en:
The UUID of the server to query. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
> You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain the UUID of a server.

title.zh: 查询暴露资产的基线弱口令风险
title.en: Query baseline weak password risks of exposed assets
